name: thread-axis-feature-identity-counterexample-v1
intent: The relevant axis is the bore center, not the outside silhouette center.
truth: The bore is an inscribed polygon whose analytic symmetry axis is x=0.5, y=0; the outer silhouette is centered at x=0, y=0. Both are real geometric features. The polygonal bore lies completely inside the outer boundary.
falsification: A fit nearer the outer center than the bore center demonstrates that identifying a circular axis does not establish feature identity. This isolated example cannot establish general estimator accuracy or assembly pass/fail.
